title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the People's Court Should Accept an Administrative Lawsuit Filed by a Party on the Grounds That the Health Administrative Department Fails to Perform Its Statutory Duties

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply concerning "Whether a People's Court Shall Accept an Administrative Action Filed by a Party on the Ground That the Health Administrative Department Fails to Perform
Its Statutory Duties
"
June 14, 1995 [1995] Xing Ta Zi No. 6
Higher People's Court of Anhui Province:
Your Request for Instructions [1994] Wan Xing Jian Zi No. 06 has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows: Where the medical accident appraisal committee has made a final appraisal that the case does not constitute a medical accident, and the health administrative department refuses to make a handling decision on the medical dispute, and the party files an administrative action with the People's Court on the ground of failure to perform statutory duties according to law, the People's Court shall accept the case.
This is hereby replied.
